Overview

Before you start, read Getting Started and How caching works. Plans are listed on this section and on our pricing page.

Step 1: Add the YouTube app

  1. Go to Files/Assets → Apps.
  2. Select YouTube and paste the video URL.

Advanced settings

Use the API if you manage many screens:

  "type": "youtube",

}
